plugins.name: billing
plugins.description: Nous Portal usage widget for Hermes Desktop — remaining spendable credits plus the plan-usage percentage in the statusbar, colour-coded (green while healthy, red when the plan is >=90% used). Hover shows plan / top-up / rollover detail; click opens the portal billing page.
plugins.author: anotherchu

plugins.name: revell
plugins.description: Revell memory provider for Hermes — verbatim boot payload delivery at session start and on compaction, cross-session identity continuity, agent-first memory framing.
plugins.author: Revell, Inc.

plugins.name: revell-context
plugins.description: Revell context engine for Hermes — compaction strategy that replaces lossy LLM summary with Revell's verbatim boot payload. Pairs with the revell memory provider.
plugins.author: Revell, Inc.

plugins.name: usage-center
plugins.description: Hermes Usage Center — local tokens plus official Grok/Codex/Claude quota, with reset-cycle usage beside remaining percent.
plugins.author: Chen Leshu

plugins.name: workspace-context
plugins.description: Shows the active session context-window usage (used / total + a percentage bar) above the desktop composer.
plugins.author: meviusisback

plugins.name: hypergrok
plugins.description: Turn your agent into a 7-role Hyperliquid trading desk: research, risk, ticketed execution and review. Portable Agent Plugin v1.7.0 with seventeen skills and seven role prompts. Includes read-only Python diagnostics; exchange writes require verified native approval coverage and ticket approval.
plugins.author: Galleon Labs

plugins.name: aihubmix
plugins.description: AIHubMix model provider for Hermes. Registers the aihubmix provider over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and filters the /model picker to tool-capable models. Install into ~/.hermes/plugins/model-providers/ or via pip; see the README.
plugins.author: AIHubMix

plugins.name: my-journal
plugins.description: Privacy-first progression journal for Hermes that turns explicitly approved conversations into validated daily Markdown with evidence, backfill, protected scheduling, and cross-platform support.
plugins.author: Jaden Gibson

plugins.name: corpus
plugins.description: Citation-backed US legal research and business-formation drafts. Portable Agent Plugin with two skills plus hosted MCP at corpuslaw.us. The agent never files and never collects an SSN.
plugins.author: Corpus

plugins.name: better-session-appearance
plugins.description: Improve your session list with full name color, bolding, a Codicon idle icon, and Auto Rules for future titles.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: drag-to-pin-session
plugins.description: Reorganize your pinned sessions with drag-and-drop. Drag a session into the Pinned section to pin it, or drag it out to unpin.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: guard-mode
plugins.description: SafeHermes: a pre_tool_call guard plus four user-typed slash commands (/readonly, /writemode, /automode, /guardstatus) to switch the guard between readonly, project-confined write, and auto modes. The agent cannot invoke the slash commands itself, so it cannot change its own restrictions.
plugins.author: cseliot

plugins.name: provider-status
plugins.description: Unified multi-provider quota usage tracking in the status bar, with support for OAuth, color-based warnings, and multiple accounts per provider with Hermes key rotation on exhaust.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: intelligent-tool-break
plugins.description: Never let a stalled tool call force you to cancel a long task. You can abort an in-flight call with /break, instruct with /break {message}, or force it to repeat with /again.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: scroll-on-switch
plugins.description: Always land at the bottom of the transcript when switching to a session, including newly mounted sessions.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: iteration-budget-meter
plugins.description: Status-bar chip that shows the focused session's per-turn iteration usage (N/60) while a turn runs, with turn peaks and the last cap-forced summary in a click popover.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Rigorous agent-engineering method for Hermes - a 45-skill agent-plugins-v1 portable package: poteto-mode router, verification playbooks, interrogation/reflect/recall loops, swarm/arena parallel workflows, and a 21-skill principle library (if you want to go fast, go deep first). Ships executable helper scripts under skills/poteto-mode/scripts/ that skills invoke at runtime - they call the bun and gh CLIs on the user's machine. Built from pinned upstream cursor/plugins pstack @ 93b00b8 (MIT, Lauren Tan). Not a straight port: upstream make-bot-ui is excluded (scanner verdict) and replaced by the locally authored skills/hermesbot (gateway webhook/send control surface). Dual-loads on Cursor.
plugins.author: iap

plugins.name: reasoning-switch
plugins.description: Statusbar reasoning-effort rotation: click the level word to cycle checked levels, gear opens a dialog with per-level themed colors, rotation checkboxes, and prompt limits that auto-demote to the next lower level.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: memory-review
plugins.description: Dialog to checkbox staged memory writes and approve or reject them.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: rss-reader
plugins.description: Three-column RSS reader with folders, reader-mode capture, feed-wide mute rules, keyboard navigation, and `/rss` commands for refresh, grading refinement, and subscription discovery.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: sessionretitler
plugins.description: Keeps the session list readable as the topic drifts. Every N titleable user messages, retitles from the latest exchanges. A title you set yourself is never touched.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: vault-view
plugins.description: Local Markdown vault workspace for Hermes Desktop with visual editing, progressive reading, cached image previews, shared tabs, tag search, links, backlinks and a graph; compatible with Obsidian vaults.
plugins.author: ergoCogn sàrl

plugins.name: opaque-composer
plugins.description: Keeps the desktop composer solid while you scroll through a conversation: it replaces the composer's translucent fill (normal and scrolled states) with the active theme's card color, so earlier messages stop bleeding through the input area. A namespaced stylesheet hooks the composer root slot and is removed when the plugin is disabled; dark, light, and glass themes all keep their look.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: compact-reasoning-label
plugins.description: Keeps the composer's model pill to just the model name: the duplicated thinking-level word is stripped from the label so the effort level lives only in the reasoning dropdown beside it. Survives every React repaint with an idempotent guarded observer and never blanks the pill.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: sidebar-manager
plugins.description: Reorder and hide sidebar nav rows and session sections from a dim list-ordered glyph next to New session. Click to enter edit mode, click a section to turn it off, drag grip handles for live HTML5 reordering. Off items hide when you leave edit mode. New session stays first; search results do not scramble the layout.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: prompt-enhance
plugins.description: Rewrite a composer draft outside the chat and put the finished prompt back in the field. Saved prompts stay in a library. A one-call model pick does not change the session.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: modernisation-engine
plugins.description: Source-read-only assessment and migration evidence engine with reviewed contracts and gated execution.
plugins.author: Sahil Saghir

plugins.name: code-assurance-engine
plugins.description: Evidence-first change assurance for immutable repository candidates: reviewer-approved checks, findings and unverified gaps.
plugins.author: Sahil Saghir

plugins.name: agent-run-debugger
plugins.description: Local-first evidence debugger for failed, stalled or expensive agent runs: deterministic timeline, evidence-led diagnosis, gaps and inert replay.
plugins.author: Sahil Saghir

plugins.name: better-capabilities
plugins.description: Delete and package skills, browse their markdown files, and save per-profile on/off presets from one Settings page.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov

plugins.name: reddit
plugins.description: Reddit with your own account behind it: bring your own Reddit API app, log in once, then read listings, search, threads and the inbox, post, comment, vote, save and subscribe under that account, plus a reddit_api passthrough for moderation, modmail, wiki and flair.
plugins.author: Apostol Apostolov
